fields.System.Title: Shelf actions name their shelf, and the overdue banner reads plainly
fields.System.Description:
Why

A screen reader announces three identical Archive buttons on a page of shelves, so a member cannot tell which shelf a button acts on. The overdue loans banner reads awkwardly.

Out of Scope

  • The Purge button. Purging is being redesigned under story 5200, so its label and behaviour belong to that story.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• A screen reader announces each active shelf's Archive button with the shelf's name, for example "Archive Picture books".
  • A screen reader announces each archived shelf's Restore button with the shelf's name.
  • When at least one loan is more than 14 days overdue, the Shelves page banner reads "<n> overdue loans — more than two weeks late".

fields.System.Title: [SPEC] Shelf actions name their shelf, and the overdue banner reads plainly
fields.System.Description:
Scope

Implements decisions for:

  • #5100 — Shelf actions name their shelf, and the overdue banner reads plainly

Implementation Decisions

  • ShelfRow builds each action button's aria-label from the shelf's name, so the visible text stays one word.
  • The banner copy lives inline in the Shelves page; no translation key is added.

fields.System.Title: [TASK] Label shelf actions and reword the overdue banner
fields.System.Description:
Spec: #5101

What to build

Give ShelfRow's action buttons an aria-label carrying the shelf's name, and reword the overdue loans banner.

Acceptance criteria

  • ShelfRow.test.tsx asserts the aria-label of the Archive and Restore buttons.
  • The lint command passes with no new warnings.
